description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request may be different.

description.zh:
QoS策略所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the QoS policy.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

title.en: Delete an Express Connect traffic QoS policy

descriptions.zh: 关联了物理专线的QoS策略无法直接删除，需要先解除关联。
descriptions.en: A QoS policy that is associated with an Express Connect circuit cannot be directly deleted. You must disassociate it first.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc delete-express-connect-traffic-qos --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --qos-id qos-2giu0a6vd5x0mv0000 --region cn-hangzhou
